stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: One order: both counts or none.

stations.title: Two sets
stations.text: A stop between them takes half an order.

stations.title: Your batches
stations.gap: No way to make two one

captions: Hesper wants an order of cards and envelopes taken whole or not at all.
Two separate sets mean a stop between them takes half an order.
You write batches that are all there or not at all, and move the stock onto them.
A stop in an order leaves both counts as they were, never one of them.
Ashgrove's stock runs on a database the shop wrote and can explain.
